Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of τέτρας (a tetrad; from G5064); a quaternion or squad (picket) of four Roman soldiers:--quaternion.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tetrádion is the word for quaternion. In Acts 12:4, delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him.
TheologicalSignificance: Four squads of soldiers guarding one chained apostle make me laugh, because no guard can hold what God means to free.
